mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 8.0% over the past 3 months signals labor market deterioration, which increases the likelihood of future monetary policy easing and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or the signal's Rank IC drops below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which increases the probability of future monetary stimulus and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression framework.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 over the past 2 months indicates a supply-side contraction, which raises inflation expectations and triggers a flight to equities as a hedge, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO falls below 95.0, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate, signals persistent inflationary pressure that triggers a forward-looking expectation of rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% yoy and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above 400,000 million dollars, combined with a rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1), indicates strong aggregate demand, which supports corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 132,000 thousand, combined with a declining unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a tightening labor market, which increases inflation expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS exceeds 132,000 and UNRATE is below 8.5%, or the interaction term's coefficient is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0, combined with a rising unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a supply-side contraction coupled with labor market weakness, which increases the likelihood of aggressive monetary policy intervention and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to predict positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's coefficient is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression framework.
